response.justification: Bogdan brings over 10 years of full-stack experience with deep proficiency in TypeScript, Node.js, React, and cloud tools like AWS CDK, directly matching the required stack. His hands-on work with AI-agent infrastructure, testing frameworks, containerization, and open-source tooling demonstrates strong architectural and problem-solving skills. His diverse background across languages (including Java, Kotlin-adjacent DLang) and domains (GIS, automation, mobile) shows exceptional adaptability and customer-focused delivery.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience with TypeScript, Node.js, React, and AWS CDK
Proven track record in AI-agent development and developer tooling
Strong open-source contributions and testing/CI/CD expertise
concerns: Limited explicit mention of Nest.js or Vitest in resume (though equivalents exist)
